Subject: Ariba supplier account verification error — kickoff & onboarding checklist

Hi Elena,

Thanks for escalating — I’m looping in Procurement and our onboarding lead to kick off vendor setup. Acme’s account shows a failed email verification in Ariba (vendor attempted signup but the confirmation link returns a "verification token expired" page). We need that cleared before we can issue the first PO.

What I need from you today:
- Confirm which email the vendor used to register (the one shown on your side).
- If possible, resend the verification link from the vendor portal and paste the exact error message or screenshot if it fails again.
- Share the signed W-9 (attached) and the completed onboarding checklist — I attached the checklist template for quick completion.

What we’ll do on our side:
- Marcus will contact Ariba support to request a token reset and whitelist the domain if needed.
- Laura will prepare a temporary manual supplier record if the portal delay threatens the PO timeline.

Next steps: please respond with the requested items and attach the portal error screenshot if you have it. If you prefer a quick call, I’m available 11–1 PT.

Thanks,

Sofia Ivanova

Thanks Elena — appreciated.

Quick technical note / workaround while we engage Ariba: please try the following and tell me which step fails (they're ordered by least disruption):
1) Instruct the vendor to request a new verification email from the Ariba portal (use a private/incognito browser).
2) If step 1 fails, try registering with a secondary contact email (e.g., procurement+redwood@acmecomponents.com) — this often bypasses stale tokens.
3) If registration still fails, we can create a temporary manual supplier profile on our side and issue a PO to that profile; procurement will need to sign off on manual entry.

I’ve opened a ticket with Ariba on your behalf: AR-998271 (internal reference PUR-2345). Ariba support has been copied on the ticket and I asked them to reset the verification token for procurement@acmecomponents.com and confirm the supplier ID once created.

Laura — can you confirm whether we can proceed with a manual supplier record if the portal remains down? Priyom, I’ll need your approval for manual PO routing if we go that route.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Procurement Ops | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Hello Sofia and Elena,

We’ve reset the verification token for procurement@acmecomponents.com and cleared the expired token from the queue. The vendor should receive a new verification email within 10–15 minutes. If they still see the "token expired" message, please have them copy the full URL and send it to us for troubleshooting.

Supplier onboarding note: a supplier ID has been reserved for Acme Components (Supplier ID: 987654). Once the vendor completes verification, the account will be active and Redwood will be able to create POs against that supplier.

Ticket AR-998271 is now in status "Resolved — actioned by support". If you require re-opening, reply to this thread with the URL showing the failure and we will investigate further.
